finding.claim: Unauthenticated POST branch fetches an arbitrary attacker-supplied URL with file_get_contents and echoes the body length, enabling SSRF to internal hosts and cloud metadata endpoints.

trace.note: Branch condition checks REQUEST_METHOD === 'POST' && isset($_POST['feed']); no session or admin check on this path
$_POST['feed'] passed directly to file_get_contents (source and sink on the same line)
Response returns strlen($xml), a body-length oracle; body itself is not returned

finding.guards_checked: Authentication: none on this branch (require_admin only guards the webhook branch). URL allowlist, scheme restriction, hostname check: none. Redirects: PHP http stream wrapper follows redirects by default and the code does not disable this, so an external redirect can reach RFC-1918 or 169.254.169.254. Scheme: file:// and php:// are not blocked (local file read beyond SSRF; only length is returned). Severity HIGH because unauthenticated and length echo is a real return channel; blind-SSRF reading would be MEDIUM.

verdict.guard_found: none. The POST branch at import.php:11 has no session or admin check, and $_POST['feed'] goes straight to file_get_contents at import.php:12. require_admin (import.php:4-9) is only called on the webhook branch at import.php:18. No URL, host, or scheme validation exists anywhere in the file.
verdict.reason: The trace is accurate: import.php:11-12 passes unauthenticated $_POST['feed'] directly to file_get_contents, and import.php:13 echoes strlen($xml) as a return channel, with no closing guard anywhere on the path.

finding.claim: Admin-gated webhook setter passes an unvalidated URL to curl_exec, allowing blind SSRF to internal hosts from an admin session; response body is discarded.

trace.note: require_admin() called; returns 403 unless $_SESSION['is_admin'] is non-empty (import.php:4-9)
curl_init($hook) creates handle with attacker-supplied URL
curl_exec($ch) dispatches the request; result is discarded
Echoes 'ok'; no response body returned (blind channel)

finding.guards_checked: Admin gate require_admin(): empty-session check only, constrains caller not target URL. URL allowlist, scheme restriction, hostname check: none. Redirects: CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION not set, PHP default off, so not followed. Response not returned, so blind; admin-equivalent access does not close SSRF to internal or metadata targets, so MEDIUM.

verdict.guard_found: require_admin() at import.php:4-9 gates the caller to admin sessions (empty($_SESSION['is_admin']) returns 403). No URL allowlist, scheme, or host check exists on $hook before curl_init at import.php:20.
verdict.reason: The trace lines all exist and match the claim (import.php:17-23), but the value reaching curl_init is $_POST['set_webhook'] (import.php:19), which is only reachable after require_admin() (import.php:18) restricts the request to admin sessions, so the source is not controllable by an unauthenticated or low-privilege attacker and the finding does not meet the CONFIRMED bar.
